secrets.name: apiKey
secrets.description: TypeSafe API key used only for POST requests to api.typesafe.ai

tools.name: classify
tools.description: Sort many items into labels in one call with Jev, a fast decision model. Returns each item's label, the probability of every label, and Jev's confidence. Use it for triage and checks: emails into urgent/reply/newsletter/junk, receipts into business/personal, a message into scam/legit, photos into contains-passport/other.

items.description: The items to classify, in order. Results refer to them by 1-based position.
An item as text, or an object with text and/or image (a PNG or JPEG path).

image.description: Path to a PNG or JPEG image of the item.

labels.description: The labels to choose from. Give each a short description of what belongs in it.

description.description: What an item needs to get this label.

instructions.description: What to judge about each item, such as "by what the user needs to do with it".

context.description: Background every item is judged against, such as the user's preferences or situation.

tools.name: rank
tools.description: Order many items by how well each meets a criterion, in one call with Jev, a fast decision model. Returns the items best first, each with a 0-1 score, the nearest level on the scale, and Jev's confidence. Use it for shortlists: apartments, job offers, restaurants, tasks by importance, photos by quality.

items.description: The items to rank. Results refer to them by 1-based position.
An item as text, or an object with text and/or image (a PNG or JPEG path).

image.description: Path to a PNG or JPEG image of the item.

criterion.description: What makes an item better, stated concretely, such as "fits a family of 4, under 2000 EUR a month, near a metro".

levels.description: Optional scale from worst to best, 2 to 10 level names. Defaults to poor fit, weak fit, partial fit, good fit, excellent fit.

context.description: Background every item is judged against, such as the user's preferences or situation.
